hero.heading: A community born from a shared longing.
hero.lead: Homeward began with people who love God, remain drawn to the life and teachings of Jesus, and want room for honest questions, deeper practice, and real friendship.

origin.image_alt: Friends and teachers gathered during a season of spiritual formation
origin.caption: A long spiritual search helped shape the questions behind Homeward.
origin.heading: Many of us were looking for the same thing.
origin.lead: A faith deep enough for our questions. Practices that help us experience God—not only think about God. Friendships where we can be honest, grow, laugh, and become more loving together.
paragraphs: Homeward is being built as a place where Christian meditation, contemplative prayer, Scripture, meaningful conversation, and shared life can belong together.
Wherever you are in your understanding of God, you are welcome to begin honestly.

formation.eyebrow: How the work is being built
formation.heading: Practical experience. Contemplative formation.
formation.lead: Homeward was initiated by Shaun Pennington, whose background brings together organizational leadership and decades of contemplative practice. That experience helps make the vision both spiritually grounded and practically buildable.

cards.title: Building something durable
items: Twenty-five years helping lead a fourth-generation manufacturing company.
Experience building culture, teams, systems, and sustainable economics.
A commitment to develop leaders and build beyond any one personality.

cards.title: Making room for transformation
items: Thirty years of contemplative study, retreat, and practice.
Formation across Christian and Buddhist contemplative traditions.
A return to a deeper life rooted in the teachings and way of Jesus.

community.heading: Homeward is meant to develop many voices.
community.lead: Participants become contributors. Leaders are developed. People help one another remember what matters, grow in love, and carry that life into the world.

meta.title: Our Story — Homeward
meta.description: Learn why Homeward began: a shared longing for deeper faith, honest questions, contemplative practice, and authentic spiritual community.
